about.title: A Dutch importer of drinks
about.p1: MK Supply Group is the trade name of M.K. Holding B.V., based in Krommenie, the Netherlands. We import, export and wholesale non-alcoholic drinks for shops, supermarkets, horeca and export buyers.
about.p2: We source from established producers such as PRAN, so you can count on reliable quality, steady supply and clear pricing.
